elements_selected.content: Extend the SPL extraction pipeline to parse (meta label (source ...)) constructs from SPL blocks per REQ-042. The source key uses spindle-core's existing MetaValue API: MetaValue::String for single references, MetaValue::List for multiple references. After theory construction (via spindle-parser), walk the parsed AST to find all (meta LABEL (source VALUE)) forms. Extract: construct (the label), source_refs (Vec<String> — either a single string from MetaValue::String or list from MetaValue::List). Parse each source_ref to determine its type: hash_ref (8+ hex chars), local_ref (^block-id pattern), cross_file_ref ([[Page^block-id]] pattern). Store raw source_refs in ExplicitGrounding::source_refs in the SplLeafCached. No resolution yet — just extraction and classification. Implement in reason feature gate since it requires spindle-core MetaValue. Add extraction to the theory construction pipeline in src/reason/mod.rs.
